title: The unsexy layer AI agents actually need: DataBahn raises $40m to sell it
excerpt: The glamorous part of AI is the models. The expensive, unglamorous part is getting them the right data. A startup just raised $40 million betting that job is the next big enterprise layer. DataBahn, a Texas company founded in 2023, has clos
content_html:
The glamorous part of AI is the models. The expensive, unglamorous part is getting them the right data. A startup just raised $40 million betting that job is the next big enterprise layer.

DataBahn, a Texas company founded in 2023, has closed a $40 million Series B led by Insight Partners, it said on Thursday. Forgepoint, GTM Capital and S3 Ventures joined. The round takes its total funding to $59 million.

DataBahn sells what it calls an “agentic data control plane.” In plain terms, it is a neutral layer between the systems that produce enterprise data and the ones that consume it, from security tools to data warehouses and, now, AI agents. Rather than shovel every log into every system, it reduces, enriches and routes only what is needed, and pulls extra context on demand.

The bill nobody can pay

The timing is not an accident. Companies now generate more telemetry than their tools can afford to process. Cloud transfer fees, storage, rising data volumes and AI inference costs are all climbing at once. Moving everything, everywhere, has become a bill few can justify.

AI sharpens the problem. Agents do not just answer questions; they act. That needs data that is current, well-structured and governed. A control plane can also decide what an agent is allowed to see, and log how each piece of data was changed and routed, a governance job that matters in regulated industries.

Less plumbing, more judgment

The product tries to move the smarts into the pipe. Cruz AI, its “data engineer,” watches for when a source changes format and breaks a pipeline, then drafts the updated parser for a human to approve. That replaces the slow work of hand-building each connector.

The pitch is landing. DataBahn reports revenue up more than 400% year on year, 180% net revenue retention and no customer churn. Fortune 100 firms in healthcare, finance, manufacturing and transport use it, including MVB Bank and the Canada Pension Plan Investment Board. It sells mostly through partners, plugs into Microsoft’s security stack, and grew out of the observability and security-telemetry world.

A crowded, buzzword-heavy field

There is a catch. Cribl, Splunk and the big cloud and security vendors all route and store data, and “agentic data control plane” is a label DataBahn has to prove is a real, separate layer. Its answer is neutrality: no lock-in to one store, one vendor or one model. It will show new features at Black Hat next month.

The wider bet is simple. The money flooding into AI infrastructure is starting to chase the plumbing, not just the models. DataBahn’s wager is that enterprises do not need to collect more data. They need to govern what they already have well enough for AI to use it.

content_html_zh:
人工智能最迷人的部分是模型。 昂贵且乏味的部分是为他们提供正确的数据。 一家初创公司刚刚筹集了 4000 万美元，押注该职位将成为下一个大型企业层。

DataBahn 是一家成立于 2023 年的德克萨斯州公司，周四表示，已完成由 Insight Partners 领投的 4000 万美元 B 轮融资。 Forgepoint、GTM Capital 和 S3 Ventures 加入。 此轮融资总额达到 5900 万美元。

DataBahn 出售所谓的“代理数据控制平面”。 简而言之，它是生成企业数据的系统和使用企业数据的系统之间的中立层，从安全工具到数据仓库，再到现在的人工智能代理。 它不是将每条日志都塞到每个系统中，而是只减少、丰富和路由需要的内容，并根据需要提取额外的上下文。

无人能付的帐单

这个时机并非偶然。 公司现在生成的遥测数据超出了其工具能够处理的能力。 云传输费用、存储费用、不断增长的数据量和人工智能推理成本都在同时攀升。 移动所有东西、随处移动，已经成为一项很少有人能证明其合理性的法案。

人工智能使问题更加尖锐。 代理人不只是回答问题；他们行动了。 这需要最新的、结构良好且受监管的数据。 控制平面还可以决定允许代理查看哪些内容，并记录每条数据的更改和路由方式，这是受监管行业中至关重要的治理工作。

更少的管道，更多的判断

该产品试图将智能转移到管道中。 Cruz AI 是其“数据工程师”，负责监视源何时更改格式并破坏管道，然后起草更新的解析器以供人工批准。 这取代了手工构建每个连接器的缓慢工作。

球场正在着陆。 DataBahn 报告收入同比增长超过 400%，净收入保留率为 180%，并且没有客户流失。 医疗保健、金融、制造和运输领域的财富 100 强公司都使用它，包括 MVB 银行和加拿大养老金计划投资委员会。 它主要通过合作伙伴销售，插入微软的安全堆栈，并从可观测性和安全遥测领域发展而来。

一个拥挤、充满流行语的领域

有一个问题。 Cribl、Splunk 以及大型云和安全供应商都路由和存储数据，“代理数据控制平面”是 DataBahn 必须证明是一个真正的、独立的层的标签。 它的答案是中立的：不锁定一家商店、一家供应商或一种型号。 它将在下个月的黑帽大会上展示新功能。

更广泛的赌注很简单。 涌入人工智能基础设施的资金开始追逐管道，而不仅仅是模型。 DataBahn 的赌注是企业不需要收集更多数据。 他们需要足够好地管理他们已经拥有的东西，以便人工智能能够使用它。
